messages:
sam: Heads up – HyperFreight just replied on H100 availability. quoted lead time 6–8 weeks, but they said they can partial-ship earlier if we cover forwarder premium.
maria: can we take a partial? we only need 40 for the west coast pool this month, rest can wait.
kevin: pricing note from them — base unit stays at our committed price for the first 100, otherwise +12% for ad-hoc. They’ll hold price if we sign a 30d deposit window.
sam: vendor also offered a conditional RMA voucher for DOA units (up to 5%) if we commit to the deposit. asking whether ops accepts voucher vs immediate replacement.
jules_hyperfreight: Jules (HyperFreight): Correct. We can issue a conditional voucher covering courier + refurb credit for DOA <=5% if Redwood signs the 30d deposit and accepts mixed AWB routing. Need AWB prefix and broker contact by EOD to lock earliest sail.
axis-bot: Quote update: AWB options:
```
AWB1: HX1234 (air, US-west, est 3 days)
AWB2: HX2048 (air, EU-shelf, est 6 days)
```
Customs HS: 8471.90 / thermal-pack cert required for sea.
maria: @sam @kevin ok to accept voucher terms? also can vendor guarantee partial-ship 40 units by 2026-05-10 if we pay forwarder premium?
kevin: conditional approve: accept voucher up to 5% and pay premium for first 40 if vendor 1) provides AWB and tracking within 48h, 2) includes depot photo evidence policy in RMA SLA, 3) signs that KMS whitelist won't block Dedicated pool handoff.
sam: I’ll tell HyperFreight to send draft RMA + voucher template and to route first 40 via AWB1. confirm broker is "BlueBridge Logistics" and they need our customs PO.
jules_hyperfreight: Sending draft RMA and voucher now, attaching sample depot photo checklist. Will mark first 40 as air-priority via AWB1 and hold remaining on the standard 6–8 week window. Thanks :thumbsup:
maria: Great — I’ll prep the customs PO and thermal cert. putting EOD reply on my list.
kevin: Note for ledger: if price +12% triggers on remainder, flag finance for reprocurement decision. also add an action for on-site thermal packing verification on arrival.
sam: Thanks team — closing loop after we have the RMA doc. reminded vendor we need AWB numbers in the next 36h.
